ask: Meta does not list location for Audience Network, but ad requests reach Meta's servers with the device IP address. Decide with your reviewer whether to declare Location / Approximate location, as most ad networks do.

Add the Audience Network SDK to your Android app (Meta)

notes: No Play Data safety guide from Meta. Meta's list for Audience Network: device identifiers; device attributes (model, screen size, OS, mediation platform and SDK versions); ad performance information (impressions, clicks, placement, viewability). Device attributes have no direct Play data-type label. Meta uses this to deliver its ads, so it is treated as shared with a third party. Encryption/deletion answers are not stated by Meta.
